# fopost_account (Data Source)

Reads one connected social account. Accounts are connected in the FoPost dashboard through each platform's OAuth flow, so they are read here, never created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fopost_account" "brand_linkedin" {
  id = "acc_01hzy8example"
}

output "linkedin_handle" {
  value = data.fopost_account.brand_linkedin.username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the account to read.

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) URL of the account's avatar.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the account was connected.
- `name` (String) Display name on the platform.
- `platform` (String) The social network the account is on, e.g. `linkedin`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the account.
- `username` (String) Handle on the platform.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the account belongs to.
- `workspace_name` (String) Display name of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_slug` (String) URL-safe identifier of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_type` (String) What the owning workspace represents, e.g. `TEAM`.
